description: The shopper's earlier orders with this store, for a reference bound to their account (a confirmed email or a connection key). orders: a list with status (confirmed, shipped, open, abandoned, cancelled), dates and totals, filtered by status and date, paged by cursor; payable marks a placed order that is not paid yet. order: up to 20 orders in full (lines with live price and stock, totals, shipping, payment, tracking, addresses) by id; an unpaid order carries pay_link. Use it to reorder or answer questions about earlier orders. The answer states what it covers and how to get the rest. Needs the order reference from start_order (Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or the ref argument).

cursor.description: orders: the next cursor from an earlier answer

ref.description: Order reference (mo1_…) from start_order, only when the client cannot send it as Authorization: Bearer

name: order_history
title: Order history
